:::{#thm-transpose-sum}
#### Transpose of a sum

For $m \times n$ matrices $\matr{A}$ and $\matr{B}$:

$$\tp{(\matr{A} + \matr{B})} = \tp{\matr{A}} + \tp{\matr{B}}$$

In particular, for column vectors $\vx$ and $\vy$ of the same length:

$$\tp{(\vx + \vy)} = \tp{\vx} + \tp{\vy}$$

:::

::: proof

Entry $(i, j)$ of each side:

$$
\ba
\sb{\tp{(\matr{A} + \matr{B})}}_{ij}
&= (\matr{A} + \matr{B})_{ji}
&& \text{(definition of the transpose)}
\\
&= a_{ji} + b_{ji}
&& \text{(definition of matrix addition)}
\\
&= (\tp{\matr{A}})_{ij} + (\tp{\matr{B}})_{ij}
&& \text{(definition of the transpose)}
\\
&= \sb{\tp{\matr{A}} + \tp{\matr{B}}}_{ij}
&& \text{(definition of matrix addition)}
\ea
$$

:::
